title: Delegation fan-in collapse does not cover the QUEUED (pending-prompt) render
outcome: Round: review of the fan-in collapse. The DelegationFanInMessage collapse only applies to settled transcript messages (MessageCard, message-cards.tsx). While a delegation fan-in is still QUEUED behind an active parent turn it renders through PendingPromptCard (session-activity-cards.tsx ~line 128), which shows the entire prompt (up to the 64 KiB truncation cap) — so a fan-in fills the viewport during the queued window, exactly the state in the user's original screenshots, and the recent 'render pending prompts immediately' fix (tm-fgh) makes it appear sooner. Fix: reuse isDelegationFanInText + the collapse presentation in PendingPromptCard. Codex review, medium.
